text: {"lessons":["My account rose from 96,876 to 100,401 over these periods, but the path was uneven; I should judge progress over the long term, not month to month.","Buying more Stock C and Stock E increased my exposure to them, so I should check portfolio balance before adding to existing positions.","Selling part of Stock A after a strong gain gave me cash, but I should make future sell decisions according to a plan rather than assume a recent rise will continue or reverse."]}
